crossRefs.note: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;
if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit…
You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was…
In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord…
The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him…
Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.
Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction…
Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil…
and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be…
But I rejoice in the Lord greatly, that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed…
May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that…
Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

translations.web: I was naked, and you clothed me. I was sick, and you visited me. I was in prison, and you came to me.’
translations.bsb: I was naked and you clothed Me, I was sick and you looked after Me, I was in prison and you visited Me.’
translations.kjv: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
translations.asv: naked, and ye clothed me; I was sick, and ye visited me; I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
